author: Kate King
title: Looking for artist for two pieces of character art
content: I am looking for an artist who has availability right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Art for new unannounced book. No specific style, post examples in replies. Thank you for replies! PA will check and reach out to move forward.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art: more realistic, epic fantasy concept art preferred, open to styles, bonus for POC. For map: detailed immersive classic fantasy-map feel. Contact via replies or DM.

author: La Biblioteca Dracónica
title: Seeking illustrators for character series for book promo
content: Se buscan ilustradores. Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes (no todos humanos: demonios, seres mágicos). Imágenes para redes sociales para promocionar libro (novela adulta con humor). Sencillas, personajes solos o en grupo. Añadir portfolio y lista de precios en comentarios o escribir en privado. Estilo sencillo, colorido. Revisaremos perfiles y contactaremos.

author: The Manila Affair
title: Looking for local artists for event posters
content: Calling all local artists! We’re looking for artists to collaborate with on The Manila Affair’s event posters. We’d love to support local talent through output-based paid collaborations! Comment below if you’re interested, and we’ll reach out!

author: Best Verse
title: Looking for illustrator or digital artist
content: I’m looking for an illustrator or digital artist! If you’re interested, DM me your portfolio along with your rates. Let’s work together! Note: prefers Indian artist. Contact via DM or Instagram.
